query: Create a content brief for 'best CRM for real estate agents' for our CRM, Homebase.

Includes dated competitive context or labels it assumption
Defines a concrete audience and a one-sentence reader outcome
Every outline H2 has a format, depth guide and evidence requirement
Plans 3-6 FAQ questions, internal links, 2-3 title options and one CTA
Lists open questions for the user
